Garlic Cheese Potato Chips
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:39am

Ingredients




20 ounces Simply Potatoes (sliced home fries)
2 teaspoons garlic powder
1/4 cup fat-free Parmesan cheese

Preparation

1 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. 2 2. Line baking sheet with foil and lightly spray with nonfat cooking spray. 3 3. Spread potato slices in single layer on baking sheet (if necessary, use 2 baking sheets) 4 4. Lightly spray potato slices with nonfat cooking spray; immediately sprinkle with garlic powder and Parmesan cheese. 5 5. Bake in preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes. 6 6. Remove from oven and carefully flip potato slices over. 7 7. Return to oven until lightly browned, about 15 minutes. 8 8. Turn oven off and let potatoes stand in hot oven until crisp.
